name: Construction Operations
description: Contractor workspace for main contractors and subcontractors: WhatsApp & email sync, Autodesk ACC & P6/MSP large-scale planning, contracts & PO/DO/Invoice cashflow, 3D BIM IFC issue tagging, and automated BIM-to-Costing-Matrix estimation with non-BIM costings.
description_zh: 面向总承包商与分包商的一体化工程工作区：WhatsApp 与邮件自动同步、Autodesk ACC 与 P6/MSP 大型进度计划、合同与 PO/DO/发票现金流、3D BIM IFC 问题标注及基于计价矩阵的 BIM 自动算量估价。
